name: processtask_collection_form
label: Work Order Associated Forms
description: The forms associated with the work orders can be used for querying related associations in workflow scenarios and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: collection_id
fields.description: Work order collection ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: form_uuid
fields.description: The UUID of the form bound to the work order, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: form_name
fields.description: Form name associated with the work order.

fields.name: form_content_hash
fields.description: Bind the form configuration to the work order. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the collection_id, form_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_hash
indexes.description: Standard index covering the form_content_hash field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
